toegepas.rede_vinder: Two main clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma (AWS 2017); the protected wording is left intact.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('Suid-Afrika het ...' and 'ons kakao kom ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required, and the protected wording 'Suid-Afrika het nie sulke plekke nie' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: in die son en word hulle meer werd
toegepas.na: in die son, en word hulle meer werd
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second clause has its own subject ('hulle') and verb, so a comma goes before 'en' (AWS 2017).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'word hulle meer werd' has its own subject and verb, so the house comma rule applies, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Many beans each have a shell, so the plural 'doppe' reads more naturally.
toegepas.fout: Singular 'dop' with the plural owner 'hul' (many beans) reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans normally uses the plural for a countable thing each of several owners has, so 'hul harde doppe' is more natural and says the same thing.

toegepas.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
toegepas.voor: voor die meeste waarde bygevoeg is
toegepas.na: voordat die meeste waarde bygevoeg word
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Voordat' is the standard written conjunction, and the present passive 'bygevoeg word' fits the sequence better than the perfect 'bygevoeg is'.
toegepas.fout: 'verkoop sy bone voor die meeste waarde' first reads as a prepositional phrase, so the reader stumbles until 'bygevoeg is'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'voordat ... bygevoeg word' removes the garden path while keeping the same sequence and the qualifier 'die meeste'.

na_skrywer.voor: Gisting is wanneer klein lewende dinge kos of sap verander.
na_skrywer.na: Die proses waarin klein lewende dinge kos of sap verander.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'X is wanneer' copies the English 'X is when'; a noun-phrase definition matches the other glossary entries and keeps the meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Gisting is wanneer ...' copies the English 'X is when' definition pattern.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may reword it, for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die boer sny die ryp pod van die boom
vlae.rede: 'Pod' is English; Afrikaans usually says 'peul' (or 'kakaopeul'). It is also the glossary headword, so it cannot be changed here; a writer or person should decide whether the term itself changes.
One pours a mixture into moulds, not into blocks, so the phrase is unidiomatic; fixing it means naming the moulds, which is a content choice for the writer.

vlae.teks: ver van die plase waar die hulpbron groei
vlae.rede: 'Die hulpbron' is vague here (it means the cocoa); 'die kakao' would be clearer, but 'hulpbron' may be a deliberate subject term, so the writer should decide.
